post.description: Dispatch one ACS JSON-RPC call.

Rotate a specific API key.

Creates a new key and marks the old one as "rotating" with a grace period.
Both keys work during the grace period. Returns the new key (shown once only).

Args:
    key_id: API key ID to rotate (UUID)
    request_data: Rotation request with grace period
    request: HTTP request
    db: Database session
    access_token: JWT token from cookie

Returns:
    New API key and rotation event ID

Raises:
    401: Not authenticated
    403: Not authorized
    404: Key not found
    409: Key already rotating

Emergency rotation: rotate all active keys for the organization.

Useful when a security incident requires immediate key rotation.
All active keys are rotated with the same grace period.

Args:
    request_data: Rotation request with grace period
    request: HTTP request
    db: Database session
    access_token: JWT token from cookie

Returns:
    Summary of rotated and failed keys

Raises:
    401: Not authenticated
    403: Not authorized

get.description:
Get rotation status for the organization.

Shows active, rotating, and deactivated keys, plus pending rotations
and keys overdue for rotation.

Args:
    request: HTTP request
    db: Database session
    access_token: JWT token from cookie

Returns:
    Rotation status summary

Raises:
    401: Not authenticated
    403: Not authorized

patch.description:
Extend the grace period for an ongoing rotation.

Useful when clients need more time to update their keys.

Args:
    rotation_event_id: KeyRotationEvent ID
    request_data: Extension request with additional hours
    request: HTTP request
    db: Database session
    access_token: JWT token from cookie

Returns:
    Updated grace period expiration time

Raises:
    401: Not authenticated
    403: Not authorized
    404: Rotation event not found
    409: Rotation not pending

get.description: Get MCP dashboard statistics

Risk score calibration: how well do risk scores predict human decisions
and execution outcomes?

For each risk bucket (0-19, 20-39, ..., 80-100) over the trailing window:
- total requests scored in that bucket
- human approval rate (of decided requests)
- execution failure rate (of executed requests)

This is the feedback signal for tuning risk-engine weights: buckets where
humans approve nearly everything are over-scored; buckets with high
execution failure despite approval are under-scored.

schema.title: Response Get Risk Calibration V1 Mcp Analytics Risk Calibration Get

get.description:
Suggest HITL policy rules mined from this org's own approval history.

This is the first *data-powered* feature — the moat. Competitors can copy
the code; they cannot copy an org's accumulated decision corpus. For each
tool the org has acted on in the trailing window we look at how humans
actually decided, and propose rules:

- **auto_approve**: a tool approved >= min_occurrences times, never
  rejected, whose worst-observed risk stayed under low_risk_ceiling.
  Safe to stop bothering a human about.
- **always_review / block**: a tool rejected the majority of the time —
  a candidate for a hard block or mandatory review.

Suggestions are advisory; nothing is applied automatically.

schema.title: Response Get Policy Suggestions V1 Mcp Analytics Policy Suggestions Get

post.description:
Receive and process Stripe webhook events.

This endpoint handles all Stripe webhook events for subscription management:
- checkout.session.completed — Activate subscription after checkout
- customer.subscription.created — Record new subscription
- customer.subscription.updated — Update plan/status changes
- customer.subscription.deleted — Handle cancellation
- invoice.payment_succeeded — Record successful payments
- invoice.payment_failed — Handle failed payments, notify user

## Security
All requests are verified using Stripe's signature verification.
The STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET environment variable must be set.

## Idempotency
Duplicate events (based on event ID) are automatically ignored.

## Response Codes
- 200: Event processed successfully (or duplicate ignored)
- 400: Invalid signature or malformed request
- 404: Organisation not found for event
- 500: Internal processing error

schema.title: Response Stripe Webhook V1 Webhooks Stripe Post
